ungrounded: The parameter register's master-table row `force-magnitude norm` has no backticked first-cell token, so the frozen C5 parser does not expose it as a legal registry_row. Its audited {1,1} effect is transparently aggregated with the K event's audited {1,1} effect, yielding K's {2,2}; this is not an identification of the two quantities.

The stage043 sources give historical register rows/effective stages but no v2.1 origin claim ids for unextracted owners. Retrospective lifecycle events therefore point origin to here/register_to_count_manifest (or the local discrete/C1/C2 census claim), the executed source of the classification, not a claim that stage043 physically introduced those knobs.
prose_script_mismatches: Cross-stage mismatch: stage032 classifies Q_E as force_mag with count_effect {low:0,high:1}; stage043's audit classifies the same Q_E as route-ful debt counted in both endpoints. Exact-once lifecycle partitioning keeps the stage032 event and emits no second Q_E event, so the composite census is [39,49] (spread 10) while stage043's range is [40,49] (spread 9). The stage043 census reading is better supported by the current rule: pending route-ful debt stays counted.

K_theta/kappa_phase-as-two -> [41,50] and the two discrete 11->12 sensitivities are recorded in prose (and the continuous sensitivity is printed) but are not defended by dedicated executable teeth; their claims remain DEFERRED/prose_only.

The live register compresses some engine-level atoms into one first-cell row (epsilon0/epsilon1, K0c plus two K1 directions, C_E/C_B, C1, and C2); lifecycle count_effect records the audit's atom cardinality while registry_row preserves the register's exact first-cell token.
judgment_calls: Expected-claim inventory and representation: continuous range -> count_range; separate discrete 11 -> discrete_postulate_count; ten-category census -> register_to_count_manifest; raw buckets and extension itemization -> bucket_partition/e_continuous_partition; C1/C2 -> c1_contributors/c2_contributors; counted-once debt -> reduction_debt_counted_once; R49 -> r49_parallel_track; scoped diagnostic -> delta_r_independence; R35 -> r35_reconciliation; OPEN/counting rule and all three sensitivity families -> convention_open/counting_rule/q_e_sensitivity/ktheta_two_dof_sensitivity/discrete_count_sensitivities.
No symbol objects are emitted: the script has no physical dimension machinery and explicitly declares dimensional homogeneity N/A for this integer-count stage.

The record_range keeps real components base_continuous=[27,36] and E_continuous=[13,13]. One joint LOW/strict axis uses endpoint-selection deltas LOW={0,-9}, STRICT={+9,0}; it yields only [40,40] and [49,49], avoids unsupported independent C1/C2 branches, and is not a dummy axis.

Ten-to-five mapping and the actual part-specific tie-break: Parts I-II follow the script's explicit raw-tally buckets, so bucket (a) universal/action maps to base, bucket (b) and C1 map to route_ful_debt, and bucket (c) and C2 map to route_less_structure; this is why register-class ACTION rows a_B, kappa_B, Omega_w, and g_l_width remain route_less_structure. Part III has no script a/b/c subdivision: its MANIFEST_FACTS group all five extension items as FREE-UNREDUCED-ROUTELESS only for the extension arithmetic, so the parameter register's per-row status supplies the finer category tie-break there; register ACTION rows J and K_theta/kappa_phase map to base, while register FREE-UNREDUCED rows rho_B0, chi_c, and B map to route_less_structure. Force magnitude maps to force_mag at the census level; discrete maps to discrete_postulate. Derived, external-bridge, departure, convention, R49, and structural categories remain zero-effect census claims rather than fabricated knob events. This category disclosure changes no count_effect or C5 total.
